references.text: The priest shall isolate the sick person for seven days, following the same quarantine procedure as for other skin diseases.
After seven days, the priest examines and may extend the isolation for another seven days, parallel to the second seven-day period mentioned here.
A seven-day isolation imposed by the priest upon examination of a skin disease, following the same pattern of repeated quarantine.
The priest isolates the person for seven days when there is suspicion of a skin disease, an identical practice regarding quarantine.
The first seven-day isolation for a scall (נֶתֶק), which this verse follows up with a second period.
Shaving as part of the cleansing ritual, linked to the instruction to shave but not over the scall itself.
Shaving of the head in connection with ritual purity, related to the shaving regulations in this verse.
